|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Stolen Data Tapes (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-L-stolendatatapes-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-stolendatatapes022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/stolendatatapes.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/stolendatatapes.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Death Star Plans”. Text: “Deploy on R2-D2. If about to leave table (even from Overwhelmed), relocate to Dune Sea (if possible). If at Dune Sea, may relocate to your character there. If at Alderaan (or a 'blown away' system), tapes 'delivered'; relocate this Effect to table and may take any card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Stolen Data Tapes (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 8 October 2022<ref name="img-stolendatatapesa48c2e8">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/stolendatatapes.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a48c2e81cc3088f72a385f3f4d68256d8012369f commit a48c2e8] (8 October 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/stolendatatapes.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' “leave table (even from Overwhelmed), relocate to” → “leave table (for any reason, even if inactive), relocate to”; “to Dune Sea (if possible). If at” → “to Dune Sea. If at”; the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); the bottom margin “•Death Star Plans” → “Death Star Plans” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Death Star Plans”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Deploy on R2-D2. If about to leave table (for any reason, even if inactive), relocate to Dune Sea. If at Dune Sea, may relocate to your character there. If at Alderaan (or a 'blown away' system), tapes 'delivered'; relocate this Effect to table and may take any card into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”
